Study
Postgraduate research
Experience a culture of ground-breaking research
Postgraduate researchers are an integral part of our University community. You’ll work alongside and learn from our world-renowned academics, while being supported and inspired to make your own breakthroughs.
Your research could contribute to the discovery of new ideas, find solutions to global challenges, and inspire new ways of seeing the world.
As a founding member of the Russell Group and a leading research university, we'll give you the platform to apply your knowledge, curiosity and creativity. Join us in pushing boundaries, shaping the future, and making a difference to millions of lives.
Research degrees
Discover our range of PhDs, MPhils and Doctor of Medicine (MD) awards. Find the research degree that matches your area of interest and submit your own proposal on a relevant research topic.
Research projects
Explore the PhD projects where we're looking for postgraduate researchers to study specific topics. Some projects are funded and most have supervisors already allocated.
How to apply for a PhD
Find a suitable research opportunity, identify your potential supervisor, and get the lowdown on how to apply.
Writing a PhD research proposal
Discover how to create your own proposal if you have a PhD topic in mind that's relevant to one of our research degrees.
Research degrees explained
Discover the key differences between our research degrees and find the option that's right for you.
Doctoral Training Programmes
Be part of the next generation of researchers, combining expert collaboration and structured training on a funded PhD.
Fees and funding
Discover ways to fund your postgraduate research. Find out more about tuition fees and the variety of PhD funding options.
Careers
From tailored careers advice to exciting development opportunities, we'll help you unlock your potential.
Why Liverpool?
Find out why Liverpool could be the place for you to shape your future, and the future of our world, with a research degree or project.

International postgraduate researchers
We can't wait to welcome you to our global city, with its dynamic spirit and pioneering opportunities. You'll join a friendly, vibrant and diverse community of postgraduate researchers from all over the world. Our international pages will help you prepare for Liverpool and show how we'll support you every step of the way.
